choices.logText: Books are gone, but broken tech litters the floor.
The cool shadow helps you rest, but you grow thirstier.

rustedTruck.text: A rusted military truck sits half-buried in sand.

choices.logText: You cut yourself, but find vicodin in a crate.
You yank out wires and panels.

collapsedShack.text: A wooden shack leans dangerously to one side.

choices.logText: A beam falls — but you salvage some bandages.

choices.text: Take the door off its hinges
choices.logText: The wood's rotted, but still usable as material.

boneField.text: An open field is littered with sun-bleached bones.

choices.logText: A can of rations lies buried near a corpse.
You power through but inhale radioactive dust.

brokenElevator.text: A mall elevator shaft lies open before you.

choices.logText: It was risky, but you find RAD-X in a storage room.
The food court is looted, but scraps remain.

dryWell.text: An old well stands cracked and empty.

choices.logText: You scream your frustrations into the void. It helps.
A small stash was hidden inside — and so was mold.

skeletonWithNote.text: A skeleton sits against a tree, clutching a faded note.

choices.logText: The final words shift something in you. You feel wiser.
You find half a protein bar and a water flask.

floodedBasement.text: A building basement is flooded with murky water.

choices.logText: You collect some contaminated bottles.
Still gross, but safer than diving in.

lockedLocker.text: You find a locker sealed shut.

choices.logText: You bust it open with effort — and injure yourself.
You leave it behind, but the missed opportunity stings.

factoryYard.text: A sprawling factory yard creaks in the wind.

choices.logText: You strengthen your arms — and twist your ankle.
Rotting metal... and a vial of RAD-X underneath.

scorchedTree.text: A tree is blackened and twisted from fallout.

choices.logText: The bark burns oddly — but it’s edible in a pinch.
The roots still glow. Not safe at all.

rooftopGarden.text: You spot a rooftop garden hidden among debris.

choices.logText: A few carrots and herbs are still alive.
A buried stash contains a single RAD-X dose.

smashedConsole.text: A glowing console lies cracked in the road.

choices.logText: Pain shoots through you, but you black out holding vicodin.
You bash it apart and grab the pieces.

barricadedDoor.text: A door is nailed shut with planks and barbed wire.

choices.logText: You’re bleeding... but there's food inside.
You see supplies, but can't reach them.

powerStation.text: A busted power station buzzes with residual energy.

choices.logText: You fry your Geiger counter but leave with scrap.

choices.text: Wait for it to cool down
choices.logText: It never does. You waste precious time.
